posts.author: BoxDeliveryAnt
posts.body:
I've been wondering if there is a way to modify the Icon or Splash Screen (the one that appears before the Title screen) of your game in RPG Maker 2003.
If there is a way, which one is recommended for a beginner like me?
Could any of this affect me if I make a commercial game if I apply those methods?
(I'm making an Undertale fangame, but I ask that last question to keep in mind if I make a commercial game with the engine someday.)

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
Use the software "
Resource Hacker
" to change the icon. For the splash screen, you can also change it there (it's the XYZ resource - you can import a new file using resource manager in the editor as XYZ file and then use that file on Resource Hacker) but please keep in mind that the patch EULA forbids removing copyright notices, so don't remove any of the existing logos. You may add a logo though.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body: You can change the icon, and you can also change the splash screen as long as you don't remove any of the logos it has already on it.

posts.author: Cherry
posts.body:
No, as long as your new splash screen still contains the existing logos and you just add more.
You can extract the existing splash screen from the XYZ resource using Resource Hacker, convert it to PNG (for example through dropping it into the picture folder and then using the export function in the resource manager), edit it (making sure the existing logos are still visible at the end), converting it back to XYZ (for example through importing it as XYZ into the picture folder using resource manager and then looking for it in Explorer) and replace the existing splash screen XYZ resource in the EXE file with the new one using Resource Hacker.
